name: bibstyle
title: Select or Define a Bibliography Style

origin.description: This function defines and registers styles for rendering bibentry objects into Rd format, for later conversion to text, HTML, etc.

arguments.name: style
arguments.text: A character string naming the style.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: (optional) An environment holding the functions to implement the style.
Named arguments to add to the environment.

arguments.name: .init
arguments.text: Whether to initialize the environment from the default style "JSS".

arguments.name: .default
arguments.text: Whether to set the specified style as the default style.

origin.details: Rendering of bibentry objects may be done using routines modelled after those used by BibTeX. This function allows environments to be created and manipulated to contain those routines. There are two ways to create a new style environment. The easiest is to set .init = TRUE, in which case the environment will be initialized with a copy of the default "JSS" environment. Alternatively, the envir argument can be used to specify a completely new style environment. To find the name of the default style, use getBibstyle(). To retrieve an existing style without setting it as the default, use bibstyle(style, .default = FALSE). To modify an existing style, specify style and some named entries via .... (Modifying the default "JSS" style is discouraged.) Setting style to NULL or leaving it missing will retrieve the default style, but modifications will not be allowed.
origin.value: bibstyle returns the environment which has been selected or created.
origin.example:
bibstyle("unsorted", sortKeys = function(refs) seq_along(refs),
    fmtPrefix = function(paper) paste0("[", paper$.index, "]"),
       .init = TRUE)
env <- bibstyle("unsorted", .default = FALSE)
cat(paste(env$sortKeys(list(list(), list())), collapse = ","), "\n")
cat(env$fmtPrefix(list(.index = 1)), "\n")

translation.description: Define and register styles for rendering bibliographic entries into Rd-like text.

arguments.name: envir
arguments.text: Optional StyleEnv holding the style routines.

arguments.name: newfns
arguments.text: Named callables added to the style environment.

arguments.name: _init
arguments.text: When true, initialize from the default JSS style.

arguments.name: _default
arguments.text: When true, set this style as the default.

translation.details: Same registry semantics as R: retrieve the default with bibstyle(), register a copy of JSS with _init=True, override named entries, and refuse modifications to the built-in JSS style.
translation.value: The StyleEnv that was selected or created.
translation.example:
from tools.bibstyle import bibstyle
bibstyle("unsorted", sortKeys=lambda refs: list(range(1, len(refs) + 1)), fmtPrefix=lambda paper: f"[{paper['.index']}]", _init=True)
env = bibstyle("unsorted", _default=False)
print(",".join(str(x) for x in env["sortKeys"]([{}, {}])))
print(env["fmtPrefix"]({".index": 1}))
